title: HDB renovation cost calculator
scope: What renovating an HDB flat in Singapore costs in 2026, line by line across 12 trades: hacking and masonry, flooring, wall tiling and waterproofing, ceilings and cove lighting, carpentry, countertops, electrical, plumbing and sanitary ware, doors, gates and windows, painting, aircon and kitchen appliances, and design fees, permits, protection, haulage and cleaning. Pick a renovation type, flat size, bedrooms, bathrooms and finish level, choose who does the work and the year, and add a contingency buffer. Prices are SGD ranges for supply and installation unless a line says supply only.
limits: Published prices: the per-unit ranges for vinyl and timber flooring, false ceilings, power points, DB boxes, quartz and sintered countertops, main, bedroom and bathroom doors, invisible grilles, aircon systems, built-in ovens, debris haulage, PE endorsement, design fees and the HDB permit come straight from the cited guides, retailers and supplier listings (2024-2026, some undated). Estimates (marked 'AI estimate'): every line whose tiers we split from a single range, converted from per sqft or per flat to per sqm, or built up from item plus labour prices. That covers hacking, floor and wall tiling, waterproofing, cove lighting, bathroom ceilings, most carpentry premium tiers, rewiring, sanitary ware, piping, windows, gates, painting, hob and hood, protection and cleaning. Provider price levels (factors) are our ratio of each firm's average or package price (Qanvast, Hometrust or its own site) to Qanvast's market midpoints. Provider price histories: 8 of 10 firms have real dated figures read from Internet Archive snapshots of their Hometrust or Qanvast profiles (Starry Homestead, Fineline, Livspace, Ovon, Dots 'n' Tots, Weiken.com and Carpenters from Hometrust; U-Home and Absolook from Qanvast), plus today's live page, and the market average uses Qanvast's published yearly 4-room resale cost. Those profile figures are averages of the firm's recent projects of all sizes, so they are noisy; Ovon and Weiken show no change, probably stale profiles. Absolook has two real readings (2023 and now) with the years between interpolated. Only FC Interior Design and Renozone are back-cast (FC from its current package and Renozone from one 2023 homeowner-reported budget, each moved along the market-average series so their yearly rate is the market's); both are marked as estimates. Future-year prices are trend scenarios, not forecasts. Excludes loose furniture, curtains, fridge and washer, digital locks, a separate project management fee (usually built into quotes), GST where sources quote before GST, and Home Improvement Programme works paid by HDB. Get itemised quotes from an HDB-registered contractor before budgeting.
subject: flat

inputs.label: Floor area
inputs.note: A 4-room HDB flat is about 90 sqm.
inputs.rationale: Internal floor area drives the per-sqm lines (flooring, rewiring, painting, cleaning). Quick picks follow HDB/MND and gov.sg sizes: 2-room Flexi 36-46 sqm, 3-room 60-66, 4-room 90-93, 5-room 110-113, Executive about 130 (some older ones up to 150).

inputs.label: Bedrooms
inputs.rationale: Sets the number of bedroom doors. 2-room Flexi 1, 3-room 2, 4-room and 5-room 3 (gov.sg Factually, Feb 2024; HDB resale listings).

inputs.label: Bathrooms
inputs.rationale: Multiplies every per-bathroom line (hacking, tiling, waterproofing, sanitary ware, doors). 2-room Flexi has 1; 3-room to Executive usually 2 (HDB resale listings).

options.label: Basic
options.note: Entry tiles or vinyl, laminate carpentry, budget fittings.
options.rationale: Low end of the published ranges: entry ceramic tiles, standard laminate, budget brands (e.g. Aerogaz hob, 4-tick aircon).

options.label: Standard
options.note: Mid-grade porcelain, better laminate with soft-close, mid brands.
options.rationale: Middle of the published ranges, matching the typical jobs behind Qanvast's 4-room averages.

options.label: Premium
options.note: Large-format tiles or stone, spray-paint or veneer carpentry, premium brands.
options.rationale: Top of the published ranges; where no premium price was found we applied Smart Calculator's finish multipliers (veneer 1.3x, 2-pac spray paint 1.45x) and marked the line an estimate.

options.label: New BTO full renovation
options.note: Carpentry, vinyl, ceiling, lighting, aircon; no hacking.
options.rationale: BTO flats come with tiled floors, finished bathrooms and (under the Optional Component Scheme) doors and sanitary ware, so there is no hacking. Qanvast's 2026 guide puts a 4-room BTO at S$50,000-60,000.

options.label: Resale full renovation
options.note: Hack and retile, rewire, re-pipe, new carpentry, doors, windows and aircon.
options.rationale: A typical full resale job; Qanvast's 2026 guide puts a 4-room resale at S$70,000-81,600. Includes the 'old flat' items BTOs don't need: hacking, rewiring, piping, windows.

options.label: Resale minimal refresh
options.note: Vinyl over old tiles, paint, new sanitary ware and lights.
options.rationale: A cosmetic refresh that avoids hacking and permit-heavy works (vinyl needs no HDB permit); the scope is our judgment of a common budget resale job.

options.label: Kitchen only
options.note: Hack, retile, new cabinets, quartz top, sink, hob and hood.
options.rationale: One kitchen remodel with the usual trades; a few new points are included because most kitchen jobs move sockets and lights.

options.label: One bathroom
options.note: Full redo of one bathroom. Set Bathrooms to 1.
options.rationale: Bathroom lines are priced per bathroom, so set the Bathrooms input to 1. Qanvast's bathroom guide gives S$3,000-5,900 per bathroom before fittings.

options.label: Two bathrooms
options.note: Full redo of both bathrooms. Keep Bathrooms at 2.
options.rationale: The same lines as one bathroom, doubled through the Bathrooms input (default 2), as in most 3-room to 5-room flats.

options.label: Partial: kitchen + bathrooms
options.note: Kitchen and all bathrooms, the wet areas only.
options.rationale: The common 'wet areas' job for resale buyers who keep the rest of the flat.

options.label: Flooring only
options.note: Hack and retile the floor; tick vinyl or overlay instead for less.
options.rationale: Replacing floor tiles needs an HDB permit and hacking; vinyl or tile overlay are cheaper lines you can switch to.

options.label: Carpentry only
options.note: Kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, TV console, shoe cabinet, study, bed.
options.rationale: Built-ins only, the largest single cost in most BTO jobs (Smart Calculator 2026: about S$10,000-22,000 for a 4-room).

options.label: Painting only
options.rationale: Whole-flat repaint with protection and cleaning; many painters include protection in their price, so you may untick it.

options.label: Rewiring / electrical only
options.note: Rewire, new points, DB box and fittings.
options.rationale: A typical resale rewiring scope (The Moneybees 2026: S$3,000-5,500 for a 4-room).

options.label: Aircon only
options.note: One multi-split system; tick System 2 or 3 instead for smaller flats.
options.rationale: System 4 suits a living room plus 3 bedrooms (4-room and 5-room); System 2 or 3 fits 2-room and 3-room flats.

options.name: Market average
options.factorBasis: The line ranges themselves. History is Qanvast's yearly expected 4-room resale renovation cost (midpoint of each year's range).

history.label: Qanvast 2023: 4-room resale S$60,720-72,500 (midpoint)
Qanvast 2024: 4-room resale S$58,000-72,200 (midpoint)
Qanvast 2025: 4-room resale S$64,300-80,300 (midpoint)
Qanvast 2026: 4-room resale S$70,000-81,600 (midpoint)

options.rationale: Qanvast publishes the same measure each year from its platform's medians: 4-room resale midpoints rose from about S$66,600 (2023) to S$75,800 (2026), about 4.4% a year. Its 4-room BTO midpoints were flat (S$56,150 to S$55,000), and BCA's tender price index rose 4.1% (2023), 1.2% (2024) and 1.8% (2025).
options.notes: The 2026 article (12 Feb 2026) was opened; the 2023-2025 figures come from Qanvast articles read via search excerpts. Midpoints computed by us.

lines.label: Hack existing floor tiles
lines.description: Remove old floor tiles and screed and cart the debris away (replacing tiles needs an HDB permit).
lines.notes: Smart Calculator flooring guide (16 Jul 2026): hacking floor tiles incl. disposal S$3-8/sqft. Converted at 10.764 sqft per sqm and split into thirds for the tiers by us.
lines.rationale: The source gives one S$3-8/sqft range; the basic/standard/premium split is our estimate. It is applied to the whole floor area, so lower the quantity if some rooms keep their tiles.

lines.label: Hack bathroom tiles and fixtures
lines.description: Strip a bathroom's floor and wall tiles, old sanitary ware and fittings.
lines.notes: MoneySmart room-by-room guide (2026, read via search excerpt): bathroom hacking light S$100-400, moderate S$400-900, extensive S$900+. Income blog (7 Feb 2025) agrees on S$100-500 for light hacking. The premium high of S$1,500 is our cap; MoneySmart's S$6,700 top includes rebuilding.
lines.rationale: Basic is light hacking (fixtures and a few tiles), standard a full floor-and-wall strip, premium an extensive strip incl. kerbs. BTO owners normally must wait 3 years before hacking bathroom finishes.

lines.label: Hack kitchen tiles and old cabinets
lines.description: Dismantle old kitchen cabinets and hob, and hack the kitchen floor and wall tiles.
lines.notes: Basic from the MoneySmart HDB guide (2026, search excerpt): dismantle cabinets and hob with minor hacking S$500-900. Standard and premium are our estimate: about 97 sqft of floor x S$3-8 plus about 270 sqft of wall tile x S$3-6 (Smart Calculator rates) plus about S$500 for cabinets.
lines.rationale: Only basic is a published price; full kitchen hacking is built up from per-sqft hacking rates, so standard and premium are estimates.

lines.label: Hack a non-structural wall (HDB approval)
lines.description: Demolish part or all of a non-structural wall; HDB's prior written approval is required.
lines.notes: Uchify wall-hacking guide (undated): S$400-900 per wall; 99.co (search excerpt) S$40-60 per foot run; EdgeProp about S$50 per foot run. Tier split ours. PE endorsement, where needed, is a separate line under fees.
lines.rationale: Assumes a typical internal brick wall 8-15 ft long. HDB only allows hacking of walls it marks as non-structural.

lines.label: Dismantle and dispose old carpentry
lines.description: Remove old wardrobes, cabinets and built-ins across the flat.
lines.notes: No standalone published price found. Scaled by us from MoneySmart's room figures (S$500-900 to dismantle a kitchen, S$400-700 for a living room; 2026 excerpt). Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) gives S$2,500-5,500 for hacking, dismantling and haulage together.
lines.rationale: Our estimate for a resale flat with several old built-ins; the tiers reflect how much old carpentry there is, not finish quality.

lines.label: Build a new partition wall
lines.description: New drywall or gypsum partition (basic, standard) or a plastered brick wall (premium).
lines.notes: No direct published per-sqm price found. Our estimate: drywall at 1.3-2x Smart Calculator's gypsum false-ceiling rate of S$6-12/sqft (two faces plus insulation); brick at S$15-25/sqft. Indesignlive (2022) quotes S$580 to about S$7,600 per partition wall.
lines.rationale: Default 8 sqm is one wall about 3 m long and 2.6 m high. All tiers are estimates.

lines.label: Floor tiling (porcelain or homogeneous) incl. screed
lines.description: Supply and lay new floor tiles on fresh cement screed.
lines.notes: Smart Calculator flooring guide (16 Jul 2026): porcelain/ceramic installed S$10-22/sqft excluding hacking and screed; its quotation guide says S$6-12/sqft mid-grade; Qanvast via Income (7 Feb 2025) ceramic S$3.50-9.50/sqft. Re-screed adds S$1-3/sqft. We set tile-plus-screed tiers of S$7-13, S$11-18 and S$16-25/sqft across these sources.
lines.rationale: Sources clash (S$3.50 to S$22/sqft); basic is entry ceramic, premium large-format porcelain. Marble runs S$15-40/sqft and can exceed premium.

lines.label: Tile overlay on existing floor
lines.description: Lay new tiles over the old ones without hacking or new screed.
lines.notes: Smart Calculator flooring guide and flooring calculator (2026): overlay S$3-9/sqft (calculator S$3.50-9). Converted to per sqm and split into tiers by us.
lines.rationale: Overlay is cheaper than hacking and retiling but raises the floor level; the tier split is our estimate.

lines.label: SPC / vinyl flooring
lines.description: Click-lock SPC or vinyl planks laid over the existing floor; no HDB permit needed.
lines.notes: Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) S$4-10/sqft, embossed S$8-10; Floor Xpert 2026 price guide from S$4, mid-range S$6-9/sqft; Income (Feb 2025) S$4-8/sqft; Qanvast: S$3,000-5,000 for a 4-room of about 850 sqft. Converted at 10.764 sqft per sqm.
lines.rationale: Ranges are sourced; basic is 4-5 mm SPC, premium thicker embossed planks with better underlay.

lines.label: Laminate, engineered timber or parquet
lines.description: Laminate (basic), engineered timber (standard) or solid parquet (premium).
lines.notes: Smart Calculator flooring guide (16 Jul 2026): laminate S$5-12/sqft, engineered timber S$10-18, solid parquet S$30-50; PropertyGuru and Income give laminate S$4-11/sqft. Converted at 10.764 sqft per sqm.
lines.rationale: Each tier is a different, sourced material. Usually laid in bedrooms only, so lower the quantity (e.g. 0.4 of the flat).

lines.label: Bathroom wall tiling (full height)
lines.description: Supply and lay wall tiles to full height in one bathroom (about 17 sqm or 180 sqft of wall).
lines.notes: Rates: Smart Calculator quotation guide (16 Jul 2026) S$6-12/sqft mid-grade; ceramic S$3.50-9.50 (Qanvast via Income, 2025); marble S$15-40/sqft. Per-bathroom totals are our arithmetic on about 180 sqft of wall. SBO.sg (2025) quotes S$3,000-4,000 for fully tiling one bathroom.
lines.rationale: The per-bathroom figure is our estimate from per-sqft rates; premium is stone or large-format tiles.

lines.label: Bathroom floor tiling
lines.description: Supply and lay anti-slip floor tiles in one bathroom (about 3.3 sqm or 35 sqft).
lines.notes: Our arithmetic on about 35 sqft at S$3.50-9.50 (basic, Qanvast via Income), S$6-12 (standard, Smart Calculator 16 Jul 2026) and S$15-40/sqft (premium stone), with a small labour minimum added at basic and standard.
lines.rationale: An estimate built from per-sqft rates; contractors often bundle it with wall tiling and waterproofing.

lines.label: Kitchen wall tiling / backsplash
lines.description: Backsplash only (basic) or full kitchen wall tiling (standard, premium).
lines.notes: Polybldg (undated, search excerpt): tile S$4.50-9.50/sqft plus labour S$3-6, so S$7.50-15.50/sqft. Basic = about 20 sqft of backsplash; standard = about 80 sqft of wall; premium = large-format or feature tiles. Totals are ours.
lines.rationale: All per-kitchen figures are our estimates from one supplier's per-sqft rate.

lines.label: Bathroom waterproofing membrane
lines.description: Waterproofing membrane on the floor with an upturn on the walls, required by HDB after bathroom floor tiles are hacked.
lines.notes: No reliable standalone price found. Our estimate is about a quarter of Smart Calculator's (16 Jul 2026) S$3,100-4,700 'hack + waterproof + retile' bathroom bundle; an unidentified snippet gave S$200-400 for the membrane only.
lines.rationale: An estimate. HDB requires a membrane when bathroom floors are redone; the required wall upturn differs between sources (100-200 mm vs 150 mm), so check with your contractor.

lines.label: False ceiling (gypsum board)
lines.description: Plasterboard false ceiling to hide wiring or create levels.
lines.notes: Helpling ceiling works (9 Oct 2025): flat gypsum S$5-8/sqft, layered S$8-12, coffered S$12-18. Smart Calculator (2026) S$6-12/sqft and 99.co S$4-10/sqft agree. Converted at 10.764 sqft per sqm.
lines.rationale: The tiers match published ceiling types (flat, layered, coffered). Default 20 sqm covers a living and dining area.

lines.label: Cove lighting / L-box
lines.description: L-box or cove along the walls with a recess for LED strip lighting.
lines.notes: Helpling (9 Oct 2025): cove ceiling with lighting S$10-15/sqft. Our per-foot-run estimate assumes a band 1.5-2 ft wide. LED strips and lighting points are separate lines.
lines.rationale: An estimate; no per-foot-run price was found.

lines.label: Bathroom ceiling
lines.description: Moisture-resistant ceiling that hides the storage heater and pipes.
lines.notes: Helpling (9 Oct 2025): PVC ceiling S$4-6/sqft. Our estimate for a 35-45 sqft bathroom ceiling: PVC (basic), moisture-resistant board (standard), aluminium (premium, rate assumed S$8-15/sqft).
lines.rationale: An estimate; no Singapore aluminium-ceiling price was found.

lines.label: Kitchen cabinets (top and bottom)
lines.description: Custom kitchen cabinets, top and bottom rows: laminate (basic, standard) or spray paint or veneer with Blum fittings (premium).
lines.notes: Smart Calculator carpentry guide (16 Jul 2026): S$200-320/ft run for top and bottom, 12 ft typical for a 4-room; cabinets.sg (2025 list) S$150; Uncle Carpenter (2026) from S$105 top plus S$105 bottom. Premium = 1.45x for 2-pac spray paint (same guide), our arithmetic.
lines.rationale: Check whether a quote is per row or for both rows, as sources differ. The premium tier is our estimate.

lines.label: Wardrobes (full height)
lines.description: Full-height swing (basic) or sliding and upgraded (standard, premium) wardrobes.
lines.notes: Uchify carpenter comparison (10 Oct 2024): swing S$210-280/ft, sliding S$230-380; cabinets.sg S$300-320; Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) sliding S$250-400. Premium = 1.45x the sliding range (Smart Calculator finish multiplier), our estimate.
lines.rationale: Default 20 ft = master bedroom 8 ft plus two common bedrooms of 6 ft each (Smart Calculator's 4-room typical).

lines.label: TV console
lines.description: Low or feature TV console, laminate to premium finishes.
lines.notes: Uncle Carpenter (2026) from S$110/ft and cabinets.sg S$150-170 (basic); Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) S$170-320 (standard); premium = 1.45x, our estimate.
lines.rationale: Default 8 ft is a typical 4-room console length.

lines.label: Shoe cabinet
lines.description: Half or full height shoe cabinet by the entrance.
lines.notes: Uncle Carpenter (2026) S$120-200/ft; Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) S$150-300/ft, which clashes with 99.co's S$250-350 (search excerpt); premium = 1.45x, our estimate.
lines.rationale: Default 4 ft; sources clash on the standard range.

lines.label: Study table with shelves
lines.description: Built-in desk with drawers and wall shelves (about 8 ft of carpentry).
lines.notes: Our estimate: basic from Uncle Carpenter desk rates (S$80-110/ft); standard = 8 ft x Smart Calculator's study rate of S$130-260/ft (16 Jul 2026); premium = 1.45x.
lines.rationale: All tiers are estimates built from per-foot rates.

lines.label: Platform bed with storage
lines.description: Queen-size platform bed with drawers or hydraulic storage.
lines.notes: Uncle Carpenter queen bed box S$600; cabinets.sg queen platform S$2,000 without storage and S$2,450 with storage; MoneySmart 2026 guide from S$2,800. The premium high of S$4,000 is our estimate.
lines.rationale: The premium tier is an estimate; MoneySmart's higher figures (to S$8,800) include extra base cabinetry.

lines.label: Bathroom vanity cabinet
lines.description: Under-basin vanity of about 3 ft in waterproof board.
lines.notes: Our arithmetic: 3 ft x Smart Calculator's (16 Jul 2026) S$150-215/ft (basic) and S$215-280/ft (standard); premium = 1.45x.
lines.rationale: An estimate built from per-foot rates.

lines.label: Countertop: quartz
lines.description: Quartz countertop, supplied and installed.
lines.notes: Qanvast/Melmer (13 Sep 2024) and Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) agree on S$120-180/ft; cabinets.sg S$100 and Carousell ads from S$95 (basic); Houzz SG up to S$220 (premium).
lines.rationale: Default 12 ft matches the bottom kitchen run. Quartz is the most common HDB choice.

lines.label: Countertop: compact or sintered stone
lines.description: Sintered stone or compact panels (e.g. Dekton at premium).
lines.notes: cabinets.sg S$120-220/ft; Melmer via Qanvast (2024) S$160-240; Qanvast 'from S$250'; Smart Calculator (2026) S$220-380 for Dekton-class. Compact panels had no separate Singapore price, so they share this range.
lines.rationale: Tick instead of quartz. Sources clash on how much dearer it is than quartz (S$50/ft more, or double).

lines.label: Countertop: granite
lines.description: Natural granite countertop.
lines.notes: Houzz SG (excerpt) S$90-160/ft; Melmer via Qanvast (13 Sep 2024) 'S$160 and upwards'. The standard high and premium are set by us at marble's S$200+ level.
lines.rationale: The standard high and premium are estimates; sources clash on whether granite is cheaper or dearer than quartz.

lines.label: Countertop: solid surface
lines.description: Solid surface countertop (e.g. KSS at basic and standard, Corian at premium).
lines.notes: cabinets.sg S$80-130/ft; metinterior S$80-150 for 'quartz or solid surface' (excerpt). Premium Corian at S$130-180 is our estimate.
lines.rationale: The premium tier is an estimate. Solid surface is seamless and repairable but scratches more easily than quartz.

lines.label: Full-flat rewiring
lines.description: Replace the old wiring of a resale flat (power and lighting circuits).
lines.notes: Per-sqm figures are ours: SK Electrical promo S$1,200 for a 3-room / 67 sqm; Uchify (6 May 2022) S$1,699-3,299 for 3-room to 5-room; The Moneybees (2026) S$3,000-5,500 for a 4-room / 92 sqm; hdbrenovation.sg (2026) S$3,500-6,500 incl. a new DB.
lines.rationale: Estimated from whole-flat quotes divided by typical areas; sources differ 2-3x, mainly by how many points are included.

lines.label: Power points (13A sockets)
lines.description: Install new or replace 13A single or double sockets.
lines.notes: MoneySmart electrician guide (excerpt) S$50-90 per socket; The Moneybees (2026) S$60-120; premium = aircon or heater points at S$120-150 (MoneySmart).
lines.rationale: Default 8 new points for a typical 4-room; premium covers heavy-load points.

lines.label: Lighting points
lines.description: New or relocated lighting points incl. switch.
lines.notes: The Moneybees (2026) S$80-180 per point; Helpling (9 Oct 2025) S$50-150 for lighting point wiring. Basic and premium widened by us.
lines.rationale: Standard is sourced; basic and premium are estimates.

lines.label: DB box (distribution board) upgrade
lines.description: Replace or upgrade the distribution board, breakers and RCCB.
lines.notes: MoneySmart (excerpt) S$400-700 for a new DB; The Moneybees (2026) S$250-800 for a DB rewire or upgrade. Tier split ours.
lines.rationale: Usually needed with a full rewire or when adding aircon or oven loads.

lines.label: Light fittings (downlights, pendants)
lines.description: Supply of light fittings; installation is in the lighting points line.
lines.notes: Lazada decor guide (Aug 2026): smart downlights S$40-120+ each, S$1,000-4,000 per flat. Basic LED downlights at S$15-40 and pendants at S$80-500 are our estimates from retail listings.
lines.rationale: An estimate; owners usually buy these themselves, so prices vary widely.

lines.label: Toilet bowl
lines.description: Supply and install a new toilet bowl.
lines.notes: Helpling (2026): budget bowls S$200-400, premium S$800-1,500+, plus plumber S$80-150. The installed totals and the standard tier are our arithmetic.
lines.rationale: An estimate built on Helpling's item and labour prices.

lines.label: Basin with tap
lines.description: Wash basin and mixer tap, supplied and installed.
lines.notes: Our estimate from retail listings: a Hansgrohe basin mixer on Lazada at S$306 and Carousell taps at S$54-79, plus installation.
lines.rationale: An estimate; no installed basin-set price was published.

lines.label: Shower screen
lines.description: Tempered glass shower screen.
lines.notes: SBO.sg (2025) S$600-850 per bathroom (standard); a Carousell fixed panel at S$230 (basic low); a homeowner report of S$1,000 for a sliding screen (premium low). The basic high and premium high are ours.
lines.rationale: Partly estimated; premium is a sliding or full-height frameless screen.

lines.label: Shower set / rain shower
lines.description: Shower mixer and set, incl. installation.
lines.notes: Home & Decor roundup: Starke and IKEA sets S$150-189, thermostatic S$329, HERA S$598; Carousell installation S$120-250. Installed ranges are ours.
lines.rationale: An estimate combining item prices and installation.

lines.label: Water heater
lines.description: Storage water heater (25-30 L) supplied and installed; instant heaters cost about S$150-500.
lines.notes: Courts and Lazada: 25 L units S$187-339 before installation; Ariston 30 L installed S$372-405 (Shopee blog); installation S$120-180+ (HardwareZone). Premium S$600-900 is our estimate incl. a ceiling cut.
lines.rationale: Partly estimated; one storage heater often serves both bathrooms.

lines.label: Water and waste piping replacement
lines.description: Re-pipe an older resale flat (water supply, plus the waste or soil stack where needed).
lines.notes: EdgeProp (undated): replacing one cast-iron pipe costs about S$1,500-2,000. An unidentified search snippet put a whole-flat plumbing overhaul at S$2,500-5,000. Tier split ours; no copper vs PPR price was found (searched 28 Oct 2026).
lines.rationale: An estimate. SingSaver advises re-piping resale flats older than 15-20 years.

lines.label: Kitchen sink and tap
lines.description: Sink, tap and connection.
lines.notes: Our estimate from retail inputs: kitchen tap S$137 (Desertcart), tap installation S$32 (Carousell); MoneySmart (2026) gives S$200-500 for sink, piping, heater and filter together.
lines.rationale: An estimate.

lines.label: Main door (fire-rated)
lines.description: HDB-compliant fire-rated main door, 3x7 ft, supplied and installed.
lines.notes: Home & Decor fire-rated door roundup (23 Aug 2025): Eazea S$800, Renovaid S$870, The Door S$899, Imperial S$1,000, Laminate Door S$1,188 incl. permit, stainless-steel laminate S$1,299-1,699. Home & Decor hidden-costs article: S$1,200-2,000.
lines.rationale: Sourced; replacing the frame can add more.

lines.label: Main gate
lines.description: Mild steel (basic) to laser-cut designer gate (premium).
lines.notes: Carousell promos S$429-529 (mild steel); Uchify (11 Apr 2022) designs from S$699 and laser-cut from S$880. The standard high and premium high are our estimates.
lines.rationale: Partly estimated; the 2022 figures may be low today.

lines.label: Bedroom doors
lines.description: Laminate (basic) to veneer (premium) bedroom door.
lines.notes: Carousell S$230-278 promo (usual price S$415); EdgeProp S$280-600 for solid laminate, up to S$1,200 for veneer. A new frame can add up to S$1,000 (Home & Decor).
lines.rationale: Sourced; the ranges exclude a new frame.

lines.label: Bathroom doors
lines.description: Bi-fold (basic) or slide-and-swing (standard, premium) bathroom door.
lines.notes: Carousell supplier listings (2026): PVC or aluminium bi-fold S$228-330; slide-and-swing acrylic S$380-500; tempered or fluted glass S$550-680; measuring and installation included.
lines.rationale: From one type of source (supplier ads).

lines.label: Window replacement (HDB-approved contractor)
lines.description: Replace aluminium windows; HDB requires a BCA-approved window contractor and a permit.
lines.notes: Carousell aluminium panels S$120-136 (basic); project-grade casement S$254 per panel and S$280-380 per window (PropertyGuru); Euro-profile S$55-68/sqft x 8 sqft (premium). PropertyGuru also gives S$400-900 per sliding window, which clashes.
lines.rationale: An estimate; no prices from HDB-approved window contractors were found. The default of 20 panels for a 4-room is our guess.

lines.label: Window grilles (invisible)
lines.description: Invisible grilles for windows or the balcony.
lines.notes: Blog and vendor sources (2025): basic S$8-10/sqft (CSA Group); standard S$12-18/sqft and S$900-1,800 for a balcony (Vocal).
lines.rationale: Default 60 sqft covers a few windows; conventional grilles were not priced.

lines.label: Whole-flat painting
lines.description: Walls and ceilings, sealer plus two coats.
lines.notes: Per-sqm figures are ours, from flat prices at 65, 90 and 110 sqm: PropertyGuru (undated) basic S$500-1,050; Uchify standard S$600-1,400; Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) premium S$1,600-5,200; Nippon Paint (2026) S$2,200-2,900 for 4-room and 5-room.
lines.rationale: An estimate; sources differ 3-4x by prep work, paint grade and number of coats.

lines.label: Feature wall / specialty paint
lines.description: Accent paint (basic) or limewash or texture (standard, premium) on one wall.
lines.notes: Qanvast limewash article (Aug 2025): S$10-20/sqft incl. labour, a living-room feature wall from S$1,000; Renonation about S$10/sqft. Per-wall totals are ours for about 84 sqft.
lines.rationale: An estimate from per-sqft rates.

lines.label: Aircon System 2
lines.description: Multi-split system with 2 fan coils, installed.
lines.notes: MissLobang (18 Sep 2026): Silverback from S$1,599 installed; megafurniture Daikin System 2 S$1,800-2,500; Courts Mitsubishi Starmex 2x12k BTU S$2,669 (RRP S$3,189).
lines.rationale: Sourced. Brackets, extra piping and power points are often extra.

lines.label: Aircon System 3
lines.description: Multi-split system with 3 fan coils, installed.
lines.notes: MissLobang System 3 comparison (18 Sep 2026): Silverback and Midea S$1,799-1,899; FixMove S$2,200-2,600, AirconDeals from S$2,980; Mitsubishi 5-tick MXY-3H28VG S$3,520-4,349 installed.
lines.rationale: Sourced; the same model varies from S$2,890 to S$4,349 between shops.

lines.label: Aircon System 4
lines.description: Multi-split system with 4 fan coils (living room plus 3 bedrooms), installed.
lines.notes: MissLobang (2026): Silverback from S$2,499, FixMove S$2,800-3,400; Lazada Mitsubishi Starmex R32 System 4 S$4,290-4,410 installed.
lines.rationale: Sourced; the usual choice for a 4-room or 5-room flat.

lines.label: Hob and hood set
lines.description: Gas hob and cooker hood, supplied and installed.
lines.notes: Carousell seller bundles (2026): Aerogaz and Valenti S$439-678, Mayer S$635-799; Courts separately S$790-870. Premium S$1,500-3,500 is our estimate from megafurniture (a premium hob 'well over S$1,000') and Fujioh's Jan 2025 price list.
lines.rationale: The premium tier is an estimate.

lines.label: Built-in oven
lines.description: Built-in oven, supply only (the cabinet maker usually installs it).
lines.notes: Courts (2026): UNO 56 L S$498, Turbo 65 L S$579, Turbo and Fisher & Paykel 85 L S$899-1,210; Bosch HBJ559EB6M S$3,499 (official list price) to HBG7764B1B S$5,199.
lines.rationale: Sourced retail prices.

lines.label: Interior design fee
lines.description: Design, 3D drawings and project coordination by an ID firm (often absorbed into the package).
lines.notes: Qanvast design fees article (28 Sep 2017, old): S$0-1,500, often absorbed; S$1,500-6,000 lump sum. MoneySmart (undated): about S$5,000 for a 4-room, or 3-10% of the job. No separate project management fee figure was found.
lines.rationale: Sources are old and clash (3-15% of the job). Contractors build project management into their margins.

lines.label: Professional Engineer endorsement
lines.description: PE endorsement that HDB may require for hacking masonry walls.
lines.notes: Smart Calculator quotation guide (16 Jul 2026): S$800-2,000 per job for masonry walls.
lines.rationale: The same at every tier; only needed for certain wall works.

lines.label: HDB renovation permit
lines.description: Permit your HDB-registered contractor applies for before works start.
lines.notes: HDB's renovation permit page (hdb.gov.sg, checked by our researcher) lists no fee; Smart Calculator (16 Jul 2026) allows up to S$50. HDB's S$100 fee is for contractors joining its directory, not for homeowners.
lines.rationale: Probably free or nominal; check with your contractor.

lines.label: Floor and lift protection
lines.description: Protective boards for floors, lifts and common areas during works.
lines.notes: Qanvast hidden-costs article: 'a few hundred dollars'. The S$300-800 range is our estimate; Smart Calculator (2026) puts permit, protection and cleaning together at S$900-2,200.
lines.rationale: An estimate.

lines.label: Debris haulage
lines.description: Lorry trips to cart away hacked debris and old fittings.
lines.notes: Carousell movers' ads (2026) S$180-300 per trip; an MND written answer gives S$300-500 per truckload. Smart Calculator (2026): S$2,500-5,500 when bundled with hacking.
lines.rationale: Default 3 trips for a full resale job; the tiers reflect access and volume.

lines.label: Post-renovation cleaning
lines.description: Professional cleaning after the works finish.
lines.notes: Per-sqm figures are ours, from flat prices: megafurniture 3-room S$200-300, 4-room S$250-380, 5-room S$320-500; homesysg S$290-550; Homejourney (Jan-Feb 2026) S$300-700.
lines.rationale: An estimate from three overlapping sources.
